notes: The לְ plus 3ms suffix of לְרַע לוֹ was fused into a single unit on his, while the same construction at 8.7 and 8.15 is read under rule 40 with the preposition unrepresented and the suffix taking the pronoun. Nothing in the source licenses the difference; only the case of the English pronoun differs, and rule 18 gives the suffix a possessive as readily as an object pronoun. Split into an unrepresented לְ and a suffix aligned to his.
